conclusions.pluginAuthoring: Use one .extend() author contribution by default; declare codec maps with its context-bound defineCodecs helper.
conclusions.htmlInput: Keep whole-input query, transformData, and transformFragment hooks flat under parsers.html.
conclusions.normalAppApi: Use inferred editor.api.<pluginKey> and editor.update.<pluginKey> namespaces in user-app code whose editor type contains the plugin.
conclusions.decoupledPortal: Use editor.plugin(Plugin).api/update in decoupled registry and reusable package code that owns the descriptor but not the concrete editor type.
conclusions.residualAdoption: The public API migration is landed; remaining product work is bounded caller conversion, duplicate deletion, and proof.

patterns: codecs must be declared with the context-bound
declared by both plugin API and editor API owners
splits plugin-owned API from the root editor API
exposes plugin-owned updates without their key namespace
Snapshot the flat whole-input HTML hooks
